videos.title: Introduction to UX Design on Wear OS
videos.why: How watch design differs from phone design, why glanceability matters for interactions that last only seconds, and which watch surfaces to design for.

videos.title: "Designing Voice User Interfaces" with Cathy Pearl from Google
videos.why: The author of Designing Voice User Interfaces explains conversation design and best practices for systems people talk to.

podcasts.episode: Conversation Design Mastery - Hans van Dam, Robocopy
podcasts.why: A trainer of conversation designers explains what the job involves and what you need to consider when an interface has no screen.

reads.title: Designing for watchOS
reads.why: The traits of a wrist display (tiny screen, raised for a glance, Digital Crown for input) and the best practices that follow from them.

reads.title: Designing for tvOS
reads.why: Designing for a large screen seen from 8 feet or more and controlled with a remote, the core of ten-foot interface design.

reads.title: Should you use Alexa?
reads.why: When voice is the right way to do a task and when it is not, plus five principles of good voice design (natural, brief, contextual, multimodal and trustworthy).
